scoring_justification: The headline quantity is the set of three adsorption energies; recompute from raw artifacts is infeasible because the verifier cannot re-run the full DFT ONIOM calculations. Comparing the agent's reported values to the paper's reported values with tolerance is the only feasible verification method.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference adsorption energies for patterns A, B, C extracted from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 5 and main text: The adsorption energy is -0.55 eV, -0.47 eV and -0.28 eV for patterns A, B and C respectively.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed verbatim from the paper's reported values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact numbers published in the paper; they are the target for reproduction.

outputs.description: DFT adsorption energies for the three patterns: adsorption energy in eV for the specified adsorption configurations on the catalyst surface.

output_contract.notes: The checker will verify each value against a hidden reference with a tolerance and check the relative ordering (more negative is stronger adsorption). No gold values are revealed.
